metaDescription: Precision engine bearing replacement for Jaguar petrol and diesel engines. Full engine-out strip-down, clearance measurement, and rebuild at our Essex workshop. Get a quote today.
lede: Replacing engine bearings on a Jaguar is a precision engineering task that typically requires complete engine removal and disassembly. Our workshop follows a meticulous process to ensure correct clearances and long-term durability.

blocks.html: Replacing engine bearings on a Jaguar is a precision engineering task that typically requires complete engine removal and disassembly. Our workshop follows a meticulous process to ensure correct clearances and long-term durability.

The work starts with removing the engine from the vehicle, followed by a full strip-down to access the crankshaft. We remove the cylinder head, sump, oil pump, pistons, and connecting rods. The main bearing caps are unbolted—each cap must be returned to its exact, original position as they were line-bored at the factory. The crankshaft is then lifted out for inspection and cleaning.

We measure the running clearance between the new bearing shells and the crankshaft journals using Plastigauge, and verify crankshaft end-float with a dial test indicator. Correct clearance is critical for oil film formation and engine longevity. All bearings are installed with assembly lube, and the engine is reassembled to factory torque specifications. Once rebuilt, the engine undergoes rigorous testing before being refitted.

For certain older Jaguar engines, bearing shells may no longer be available from the manufacturer, and aftermarket alternatives may be limited. In some cases, if the bearing saddles are damaged, the crankcase must be line-bored—a specialist machining operation. Our workshop has the equipment and expertise to handle these complexities.
For a deeper look at our quality checks during a full rebuild, read our guide: [What We Check On Every Rebuild, Every Time](/guides).

steps.body: We remove the engine from the vehicle and fully disassemble it, taking care to mark every component for exact re-installation.
We unbolt the main bearing caps in sequence, ensuring each cap is retained for its original position. The crankshaft is then lifted out.
All components are thoroughly cleaned, and the crankshaft journals are inspected for wear or damage. Swarf is removed from oil galleries.
Using Plastigauge, we measure the running clearance for each bearing. We also measure crankshaft end-float with a dial test indicator.
We fit new main bearings, big-end bearings, and thrust washers. Assembly lube is applied, and bearing caps are torqued to factory specs.
We reassemble the engine, refit it to the vehicle, and conduct a full road test to ensure everything is operating correctly.

items.a: It involves removing the engine, stripping it down, and replacing the main bearings, big-end bearings, and thrust washers that support the crankshaft. This is a precision engineering task that requires measuring clearances and torquing to factory specifications.

items.q: Does my Jaguar engine need to be removed for bearing replacement?
items.a: Yes, for a complete and proper replacement of all main bearings, the engine must be removed from the vehicle. This allows full access to the crankshaft and ensures all tolerances are measured correctly.

items.q: How long does bearing replacement take?
items.a: The typical turnaround is 3-5 working days, depending on the engine type and any additional machining required (such as line-boring). We will give you a clear timeline when we inspect your vehicle.

items.q: What is Plastigauge and why is it used?
items.a: Plastigauge is a thin plastic strip that is placed between the bearing and the journal. When the bearing cap is torqued, it flattens; the width of the flattened strip indicates the running clearance. This ensures the bearings are neither too tight nor too loose.

items.q: Do you offer a warranty on bearing replacement?
items.a: Yes, all our engine bearing replacement work comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty for your peace of mind. [Full warranty details here](/warranty).
